Hopalong Cassidy (William Boyd) and his Bar-20 buddies stop a saloon owner (Evelyn Brent) and her rustler partner (Victor Jory).

programme.desc: Stan and Ollie rescue Bo-Peep, Tom-Tom and other Mother Goose characters from Toyland miser Barnaby.
programme.title: March of the Wooden Soldiers

programme.desc: When a persistent posse threatens two outlaws' (Paul Newman, Robert Redford) romp through Wyoming, they decide to take their act to Bolivia.
programme.title: Butch Cassidy and the Sundance Kid

programme.desc: Rebel trucker "Rubber Duck" (Kris Kristofferson) blocks a crooked sheriff (Ernest Borgnine) with a CB-linked army of big rigs.
programme.title: Convoy

programme.desc: Two buddies win a car and head for Hollywood to meet Anita Ekberg.
programme.title: Hollywood or Bust

programme.desc: A New York corporate boss (Everett Sloane) grooms an Ohio engineer (Van Heflin) for the No. 2 man's (Ed Begley) job.
programme.title: Patterns

programme.desc: A singing cowboy (Gene Autry) saves a señorita (Elena Verdugo) from a former rodeo star (Stephen Dunne) who likes her big ranch.
programme.title: The Big Sombrero

programme.desc: A woman (Millie Perkins), two bounty hunters and a gunman (Jack Nicholson) ride into a desert and run out of water.
programme.title: The Shooting

programme.desc: A dead playboy's (Emlyn Williams) letter makes three of his friends think he was intimate with their wives.
programme.title: Three Husbands

programme.desc: Mr. Dithers leaves Dagwood in charge, ripe for swindlers until Blondie saves the day.
programme.title: Beware of Blondie

programme.desc: In the 1800s California, a man in the grip of gold fever deserts his family to scour the hills for the precious metal.
programme.title: The Naked Hills

programme.desc: Family members and gangsters complicate the wedding plans of two rebellious teenagers.
programme.title: Date Bait

programme.desc: In a Nazi prison barracks, other POWs believe that a cynical American sergeant (William Holden) is an informer.
programme.title: Stalag 17

programme.desc: Socialite Irene Bullock needs a forgotten man to win a scavenger hunt and finds Godfrey Park, who resides in a dump by the East River. She hires him as a butler, to the chagrin of her spoiled sister Cornelia, who seeks to get Godfrey fired.
programme.title: My Man Godfrey

programme.desc: A bored millionaire (Cary Grant) steps into big business without his fortune or position just to prove he can survive on his own.
programme.title: The Amazing Adventure

programme.desc: Blondie (Penny Singleton) and Dagwood (Arthur Lake) send Baby Dumpling (Larry Simms) to military school, then go back to college.
programme.title: Blondie Goes to College

programme.desc: A singing lawman (Gene Autry) has a ghost-town showdown with crooks his father jailed 20 years before.
programme.title: Rim of the Canyon

programme.desc: An astronaut and his team crash on a world ruled by intelligent, talking simians who treat humans like animals.
programme.title: Planet of the Apes

programme.desc: Superspy Derek Flint (James Coburn), agent of Z.O.W.I.E., stops a geothermal plot to control the world's weather.
programme.title: Our Man Flint

programme.desc: A dried-out heroin addict (Frank Sinatra) returns to his wife (Eleanor Parker) and card dealing in Chicago.
programme.title: The Man With the Golden Arm

programme.desc: A woman contemplating divorce from her husband recalls their early years together and the tragedies that ensued.
programme.title: Penny Serenade

programme.desc: A psychiatrist (Vincent Price) and a nurse (Lynn Bari) treat a veteran's (Frank Latimore) wife who has seen them kill the psychiatrist's wife.
programme.title: Shock

programme.desc: Lawyer's (John Litel) daughter Nancy (Bonita Granville) and her boyfriend (Frankie Thomas) rescue an old woman from crooks.
programme.title: Nancy Drew, Detective

programme.desc: A British gentleman's (Laurence Olivier) innocent bride (Joan Fontaine) grapples with intrusive reminders of his deceased wife.
programme.title: Rebecca

programme.desc: A naughty little girl (Shirley Temple) dreams she and her brother are sent by a fairy to find the bluebird of happiness.
programme.title: The Blue Bird

programme.desc: Two gangsters join the French Foreign Legion to elude their enemies.
programme.title: We're in the Legion Now

programme.desc: Flashbacks tell the story of a tenderfoot who rose to glory by gunning down the outlaw terrorizing his small town.
programme.title: The Man Who Shot Liberty Valance

programme.desc: U.S. soldiers (Van Johnson, John Hodiak, Ricardo Montalban) from all over fight in the Battle of the Bulge.
programme.title: Battleground

programme.title: Munster, Go Home

programme.title: Johnny Yuma

programme.title: The Color Purple

programme.title: Hopalong Cassidy Enters

programme.title: Get Christie Love!

programme.title: Gun the Man Down
